summary: From 1953 the CIA's MKUltra program, run by chemist Sidney Gottlieb, secretly dosed, tortured and psychologically destroyed prisoners, patients and unwitting civilians in the US, Canada and abroad in a failed hunt for mind control, then burned its records.

Operation Sea Spray: Army and CIA spray bacteria over San Francisco
Edward Hunter, a CIA contractor, stokes the brainwashing panic
Bluebird black sites in West Germany, then Japan, drugging Korean POWs
Stanley Glickman dosed in a Paris cafe and ruined
Dulles formally launches MKUltra in April 1953 under Gottlieb
Ewen Cameron's CIA-funded depatterning at McGill in Montreal
Frank Olson's fall from a New York hotel window, suicide versus murder
George White's San Francisco safe-house brothel for covert LSD dosing
Louis Jolyon West segment: false-memory claims and the Shaver case
long discussion of Manson, JFK and conspiracy culture fed by MKUltra
Gottlieb testifies to Congress after destroying the files

notes: Primary subject is the program itself (kind event), so roles are empty. Main span ends 1972 because the host dates Helms's file-destruction order to 1972; most sources put it in early 1973. Covered span ends with the Church Committee and Gottlieb's 1977 testimony; later lawsuits and Gottlieb's 1999 death are brief codas. Frank Olson and Allen Dulles also have real segments but are keywords to keep five subjects. KR and PA (Dimitrov) were close calls for setting.
